question: What happens if I use a new phone with HeartBug?
short_answer: If you change phones, unpair HeartBug (or turn off Bluetooth) on the old phone, install the app on the new phone, log in with your mobile number, and keep Bluetooth/internet on. Contact Patient Care if you need help.
long_answer: If you change phones, first unpair the HeartBug device or turn off Bluetooth on the previous phone. Install the HeartBug app on the new phone and log in with your mobile number. Once set up, keep Bluetooth and internet on and HeartBug will connect automatically. If you need help, contact the Patient Care Team.

question: Can I do a manual recording in the background?
short_answer: Yes. Manual recordings keep running even if your screen is off or the app is in the background. They also work in airplane mode, while charging, silent mode, or without Wi-Fi/internet.
long_answer: You do not need to keep the screen on while a manual recording is running. The recording continues normally even if your phone screen is off. Manual recordings work in airplane mode, when the phone is charging, in silent mode, without Wi-Fi, during sleep mode, without internet, or while on speaker mode.
